impact.derivation: Counted the discovered cohort in its candidate window and compared its resolution with the discovered peer baseline; no historical before-period was available.

findings.if_nothing_changes: The new product cohort continues generating unresolved conversations and unnecessary human handoffs.

evidence: declared tool failure rate remains flat while silent-success calls spike

impact.derivation: Compared the affected intent after a discovered tool change with its pre-change baseline; silent successful calls and retries identify the contract failure.

findings.if_nothing_changes: The changed tool can continue returning empty successful responses that drive avoidable retries and unresolved conversations.

evidence: median turns rise from 4.0 to 6.0 while resolution remains 0.803 versus 0.782

impact.derivation: Compared the affected agent after a discovered prompt change with its own pre-change turns, cost, and resolution baseline.

findings.if_nothing_changes: The changed prompt can continue adding turns and cost even when resolution alerts remain quiet.

prescriptions.description: Add and index the missing knowledge content used by the affected cohort.

decision.asking_approval_for: Replay the content addition before any production change; do not ship if the golden set regresses.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: The diagnosis could be wrong and the content may not address the underlying policy or routing issue.
decision.would_not_ship_if: Replay returns no_effect or regressed, or the golden set fails.

prescriptions.description: Reject empty successful payloads and route them through the existing fallback path.

decision.asking_approval_for: Replay payload validation before production rollout; do not ship until the orders team confirms empty 200 responses are invalid.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: A legitimate empty order response could be converted into an unnecessary fallback or handoff.
decision.would_not_ship_if: Replay returns no_effect or regressed, or the golden set fails.

prescriptions.description: Remove wording that causes unnecessary extra turns while preserving safety behavior.

decision.asking_approval_for: Replay the prompt edit and require no golden-set regression before release.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: Reducing confirmations could remove a useful safety check and change behavior outside the affected cohort.
decision.would_not_ship_if: Replay returns no_effect or regressed, or the golden set fails.

gaps.why: The runtime does not emit an event showing a primary target failing and an alternate target serving the user.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: A retry may call the same target again and does not prove failover.

self_assessment.notes: One replay cycle completed; results are recorded but not used to downweight a change class.
